name: Stormbringer: Storm Clouds doubles Body of Lightning and self-casts it (#2797)
contract: #2797: Storm Clouds 705686 reads 'Doubles the damage of Body of Lightning and it now automatically casts on you when you cast it on an ally.' Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and amount EffectBasePoints 99 + EffectDieSides 1 = +100%, on a class mask of 4194304 in word 1, which is the SpellFamilyFlags[1] of 800406 Body of Lightning (damage); Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies that modifier natively, so a base of 100 must read 200 with the passive. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (42) on 520843 'Cloudy', whose SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL casts 500041 Body of Lightning on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER: casting the ally buff must therefore leave the same buff on the caster. Spell.dbc gives 705686 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returned a zero mask: only the damage half worked. 500041 is TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, costs 25 Static (AscensionCustomResourceData.h ResourceCostRules, class 16) and lasts 12000 ms, which is why the ally cast is fixtured with 80 Static and read back inside three seconds.
